opening.argument: The presentation instructs viewers to send approximately $200 in AVAX to a contract and to invoke a flashloan function in Remix, making the opportunity directly actionable. It then presents an unusually rapid increase from $200 to $1,775, while attributing the anticipated profit to rapid trading that inflates the coin's value. The encouragement to spread the word and act while possible reinforces the promotional character of the method. Although the description says, "This worked for me. But TRY IT AT YOUR OWN RISK.", that warning limits certainty about safety or reproducibility without removing the material significance of the funding instructions and claimed return.
